text:
maya: Heads-up — we just got a support escalation from Acme about p95/p99 latency regressions on our text-gen endpoint. They started seeing spikes ~10:15 PDT after yesterday's runtime deploy. p95 from ~120ms -> ~430ms, p99 to 2.4s.
alejandro: thanks — any correlation with model or sequence lengths?
maya: customer says these are long prompts (avg 1500 tokens), tail latency only. Short queries unaffected.
ryan: that screams kernel/attention change. Yesterday's deploy flipped default to FlashAttention-enabled kernels for xformers variants + SDPA fallback.
sylvie: Confirming — rollout note: runtime v3.8.1 toggled compile flag `-DENABLE_FLASHATTN=1` and altered kernel selection policy to prefer FA kernels on A100 & H100.
maya: can we rollback the kernel preference for Acme tenant or at least toggle per-tenant? They are on Dedicated pool id:d-42 (H100s).
ryan: quick mitigation: switch their routing policy to SDPA-only for that model. Command: `rdwctl route update --tenant d-42 --model oak-13 --policy prefer_sdpa`
maya: doing that now — pausing to confirm no side effects.
ops-bot: deploy triggered: change-route d-42 oak-13 -> prefer_sdpa (user: maya) — started 2025-11-18T17:22:40Z
maya: route change applied. Monitoring.
alejandro: while we wait, can we reproduce locally? I can spin up same model with FA on H100 emulator. Need exact kernel selection logs.
ryan: logs are in kibana: `service=runtime kernel_selection model=oak-13 pool=d-42` filter for kernel name. I grabbed a sample: `selected_kernel=flash_attn_v2 seq_len=1536 batch=1 latency_tokens_ms=0.35 token_ms=1.22` then later `kernel_fallback=sdpa reason=nvptx_timeout` — but also cases where kernel used FA but latency still high.
sylvie: two hypotheses: 1) FlashAttention kernel path has regression for long seqs on our compiled kernel (bad tiling) 2) autopatcher for KV cache/batching interacts poorly with FA causing bad scheduling -> increased queuing.
alejandro: good point — there was a change to kernel tiling heuristics in compiler flags: `-DFA_TILE=64` -> `-DFA_TILE=128` in the last build. Might underutilize SMs for certain seq lengths.
ryan: can we toggle FA tiling back to 64 in a canary build and bench?
sylvie: yes — build matrix: `BUILD_FLAGS="-DENABLE_FLASHATTN=1 -DFA_TILE=64"` and compare kernel perf vs `-DFA_TILE=128`. I can push artifacts to canary pool.
maya: customer reports p95 dropping back to ~140ms after the SDPA route change. p99 still has a few spikes but much improved.
ops-bot: metric alert cleared: acme.oak-13.p95 latency > 300ms -> resolved 2025-11-18T17:28:10Z
alejandro: repro steps I used: 1) fetch sample prompt (1500 tokens) from Acme logs 2) run locally with `rdw-run --model oak-13 --seq 1536 --batch 1 --kernel flash_attn_v2` 3) measure 1000 requests with `wrk`. Observed median token ms ~1.1 but 95th ~3.8 ms/token (higher than expected).
sylvie: add tracing `RUNTIME_DEBUG=kernel_trace` — capture kernel selection and PTX timings. Also enable `KV_DEBUG=1` to see cache hits/evicts.
ryan: provisional mitigation plan: 1) keep tenant on SDPA policy until root cause is confirmed 2) add per-tenant kernel-selection override UI 3) revert FA tiling change in next patch if canary shows regressions
maya: customer sent repro case and offered access to their sample workload in our staging. I'll coordinate.
alejandro: note — we should check compiler toolchain upgrade in the last CI build. We moved from cuda 12.2 -> 12.3 and that can change kernel perf.
sylvie: right. matrix to validate: (a) cuda12.2 + FA_TILE=64, (b) cuda12.3 + FA_TILE=64, (c) cuda12.3 + FA_TILE=128. Prioritize (b) vs (c).
ryan: I'll add an experiment to CI perf lab to run these 3 configs overnight. If FA regressions persist on 12.3, we either pin toolchain or adjust kernel code.
ops-bot: experiment queued: perf-lab/cuda-kernel-matrix (user: ryan) — job id 8942
maya: short-term message to Acme: "We found a kernel-level regression that affects long-context workloads on certain GPU toolchain builds. We've routed your traffic to an alternative kernel path which should restore p95/p99; we're running validation and will follow up"
alejandro: follow-ups: gather kernel PTX timings, nvprof traces, and the `rdwctl kernel list --stats` snapshot for the affected timeframe. Also grab the batching window histogram; if batching latency increased it's a scheduler problem not just kernel perf.
sylvie: I'll own a patch to add an automated canary for kernel tiling changes: whenever we change tile/compile flags, run the standard long-context benchmark and block rollout on >15% p95 regression.
ryan: agreed. Also add a config flag `runtime.experimental.force_sdpa_for_seq_len>=1024` so we can auto-fallback on long sequences until FA is verified.
maya: thanks team — keeping customer updated. I'll post updates here and when we have CI results. :thumbsup:
